effects.effect: Giving up is for other people. You gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) made using the [Endurance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.exploration/endurance) skill. Additionally, when you are [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed), your [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) is reduced to 3 instead of 2.
